A1.justification: Both readable ten-page PDFs describe the same SIED dataset and enhancement method, with comparable text, equations, figures and tables. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix; both end with references.

before.justification: v1 reports original dataset-calibration measurements, SIED and SID benchmark results, real-world image restoration, and ablation experiments in Tables 1-4 and Figures 6-9.

after.justification: v2 retains these original calibration, benchmark, real-world restoration and ablation results in Tables 1-4 and Figures 6-9.

M1.justification: The paired-to-paired synthesis pipeline, latent diffusion architecture, AICM, loss functions, two-stage training and inference procedure remain unchanged in Sections 3-4.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate SIED Canon/Sony images across the same three illuminance ranges, SID Sony/Fuji images, and real-world extremely dark Sony scenes. No dataset or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Tables 2-3 retain SID, DID, SGN, LLPackNet, RRT, LDC, MCR, DNF and RAWMamba, with identical subset availability. Figures 6-8 also retain their respective comparator sets.

E3.justification: The 1,500/180 SIED training/evaluation split, training budgets, diffusion settings and PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS metrics are unchanged. The SID illuminance description removed from Section 5.1 repeats information retained in Sections 1-2.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 retains the single-stage training, AICM removal, fixed amplification and color-loss ablations, with unchanged Table 4 and Figure 9 evidence. The Figure 8 real-world generalization analysis is also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both retain the same statistical reporting, including mean KL divergence and benchmark point estimates. Neither reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or statistical tests.

E6.justification: All values in Tables 1-4 match, including the method's Canon 0.01-0.1 lux results of 24.85 PSNR, 0.849 SSIM and 0.360 LPIPS. The qualitative examples and findings in Figures 6-9 also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1-7 and their mathematical explanations remain unchanged, including illumination alignment, diffusion formulations and training losses. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about calibrated SIED data, diffusion-based restoration with AICM and color consistency, and superiority over existing methods.

C2.justification: Interpretations of staged training, adaptive exposure correction, color consistency and real-world generalization remain unchanged. No substantive limitations, failure conditions or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: Camera and noise-synthesis details, PyTorch/A100 implementation, optimizer, hyperparameters and the code/data access statement remain unchanged. No additional technical reproducibility information is supplied.

R1.justification: Both versions retain the same 43 references and the same positioning relative to earlier enhancement methods and low-light datasets.

P1.justification: v2 corrects an affiliation marker from 3 to 4, adds author emails and funding acknowledgements, removes repeated SID illuminance prose, and shortens Section 5.3 wording. Section order and the scientific narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 reformats the author/affiliation block, removes printed page numbers, and reflows experimental and concluding text around the acknowledgements. All nine figures and four tables retain their visual content and organization.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects author metadata, adds contact and funding information, and trims a few repetitive sentences. These provide slight editorial polish, while the methods, evidence, explanations and reproducibility information remain unchanged, producing no meaningful overall quality difference.
